cost_model.basis: Track 3's measured market-order round trip, scaled by basket gross exposure
cost_model.charged: on realised turnover, every rebalance, both legs

cv_architecture.purge_bars: the full forward horizon of the target

forbidden_rescues: adding a feature after seeing a fold
changing the horizon after seeing a fold
flipping the sign of a failing model
adding a regime condition that isolates the losing period
re-running with a different seed and reporting the better one
reading any protected span for any purpose
kill_rule: the fitted model does not beat its declared baseline by the minimum relevant incremental information ratio
out-of-fold net annualised return is negative
the result does not survive the stressed cost multiple
fewer than three quarters of folds are positive
fewer than five currencies contribute positively
the ten largest days are more than half of the net
the effect is confined to one volatility regime
any leakage control is found to have been violated
leakage_controls: features use closed bars only, evaluated at the bar after the decision
forward windows are purged and embargoed across every fold boundary
any normalisation is fitted inside the training fold and applied forward
the cross-sectional neutralisation uses only same-bar information

maximum_research_budget.level_2_not_run_because: the capacity budget, not the validation result

multiple_testing_controls: one fitted configuration per track, declared before any fit
three tracks, whose phase-level selection inflation is computed and reported
no hyperparameter search, no feature selection, no threshold sweep outside a fold
the baseline comparison is an absolute threshold, not a maximum over candidates
the roughly 1,200 configurations already run against these spans are disclosed and are NOT corrected for — nothing in a seen-data phase can correct for them

pre_execution_corrections.why: a day-constant feature has exactly zero covariance with a cross-sectionally demeaned target, so its coefficient is unidentified by construction; the replacement is per currency and in the same family
regressing a currency on an average that contains it biases the beta upward by arithmetic alone, since one eighth of the factor is the regressand

pre_execution_corrections.now: a regime-dependent gain on a shared slope vector
pre_execution_corrections.why: the same identification problem: an intercept is identical across currencies on a day. The capacity cost is unchanged, the quantity estimated is not
the M15 caches these three routes produced carry no volume column

pre_execution_corrections.now: distance to the nearest decision of the four acquirable banks
pre_execution_corrections.why: only AUD, EUR, JPY and USD publish an acquirable calendar, so a per-currency anchor is a dummy for those four currencies, which a model would learn and the breadth requirement would then fail

pre_execution_corrections.now: a forward-excess-return target with cost charged at construction
pre_execution_corrections.why: a leg cost depends on how much its position changes, which depends on the prediction, so a per-leg adjustment is not identified before the position exists. Every clause of the success rule is stated in net terms

tracks.baseline: Level 0: the unfitted equal-weight cross-sectional rank of currency_excess_return_20d_z alone, long the top two and short the bottom two, at the same turnover and the same cost model
tracks.cross_section: 8 G10 currencies, one shared coefficient vector
tracks.regularisation: ridge, penalty chosen by the declared effective-degrees-of-freedom target of 4.2 inside each training fold — a target, not a tuned hyperparameter
tracks.target: the next UTC day's return of each G10 currency against the equally weighted basket of the other seven, minus the round trip charged on the rebalance that establishes the position

tracks.baseline: Level 0: the same four features with a single shared gain and no regime split, which isolates what the state itself is worth
tracks.cross_section: 8 G10 currencies, shared slopes, per-state gain
tracks.regularisation: ridge to an effective-degrees-of-freedom target of 2.4 on the slopes
tracks.state_variable: a two-state split on the 60-day realised volatility of the currency basket, thresholded at its expanding-window median inside the training fold only
tracks.target: the same cost-adjusted next-day currency-against-basket return, with the GAIN on a shared slope vector — not the slopes themselves — allowed to differ between two states. A regime-dependent intercept is identical across currencies on a day and the target sums to zero across them, so an intercept is unidentified here by construction

tracks.base_opportunity: every daily currency leg on which Track A's baseline takes a position. Its unconditional cost-adjusted expectancy is measured FIRST and is a kill rule: if the base is negative, a filter inside it is not evidence
tracks.baseline: Level 0: take every leg in the base opportunity, no filter
tracks.regularisation: ridge to an effective-degrees-of-freedom target of 3.6
tracks.target: the probability that a currency leg's absolute next-day move exceeds its own round trip, with the accept threshold fitted inside the training fold
